anomalies.observed: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet the magnetometer U8 (IIS2MDCTR) has its SCL/SPC pin (1) wired to global label I2C4_SCL_NAVC and its SDA/SDI/SDO pin (4) wired to I2C4_SDA_NAVC. The Navigation Computer sheet (NAVC1, STM32F405RGTx) carries no pin with either I2C4_*_NAVC label, and the NAVC I2C pull-up block (R28–R31) only pulls up I2C1 and I2C3, so the magnetometer's two bus lines are driven by nothing and are not pulled up.
anomalies.expected: The STM32F405RGTx has only I2C1, I2C2 and I2C3 peripherals (no I2C4), and the specification states the NAVC 'gathers IMU, magnetometer, pressure sensor and GPS receiver data'. The magnetometer's SCL/SDA must therefore be tied to a real, MCU-driven, pulled-up I2C bus (e.g. the I2C1 sensor bus used by the BMI088, TMP100, MPRLS and EEPROM).

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals sheet: U8 IIS2MDCTR pin 1 'SCL/SPC' -> I2C4_SCL_NAVC, pin 4 'SDA/SDI/SDO' -> I2C4_SDA_NAVC (note 'I2C address: 0x1E')
Navigation Computer sheet: I2C pull-up block contains only I2C1_*_NAVC (R28,R29) and I2C3_*_NAVC (R30,R31); no I2C4_*_NAVC appears on any NAVC1 pin
Navigation Computer (NAVC) — gathers IMU, magnetometer, pressure sensor and GPS receiver data

anomalies.impact: The magnetometer's I2C lines are not connected to any functioning I2C peripheral on the NAVC, so the STM32F405 cannot communicate with the IIS2MDCTR; heading/orientation data from the magnetometer would be unavailable, contradicting the intended sensor suite.

parsed.summary: The build otherwise matches the specification (including the documented barometer RESET/EOC swap and the MAX-7Q/MAX-8Q footprint note), but the magnetometer U8 is wired to I2C4_*_NAVC nets that no STM32F405 pin drives and that are not pulled up, leaving the magnetometer's I2C bus floating and unreadable by the NAVC.
